reason: Re-opened al-Tabari via packet.js quran 53 --verse 41.34: the segment is one comment on 41:33 to 41:34, and the quoted words stand verbatim in his own voice (yaqūl taʿālā dhikruhu li-nabiyyihi): repel with forbearance the ignorance, with pardon the offence, with patience the hurt; then the offender becomes, through kindness, like a friend from among your cousins, near in kinship (al-ḥamīm: al-qarīb). This is his own reading, given first, before the reported alternative that the better thing is the greeting of peace (ʿAtaʾ, Mujahid); the entry claims no preference over it and no more than his words carry. Plain sense checked against day.js 41:33 to 41:36: Pickthall has him who prayeth unto his Lord and doeth right; the addressee thee is named O Muhammad in 41:36, so the Prophet is taught is within the text and the brief voice. verse.js ok (Fussilat 41:34, at 4251); entry-check ok. No comparison, no school needed, no hard passage.
